heading: Our Menu
subtitle: At Tequila Mockingbirds, we believe exceptional drinks start with feel-good ingredients. We’ve reimagined the classic frozen margarita with a wellness-inspired twist—blending 100% premium blue agave tequila with natural agave nectar, cold-pressed citrus, and pure fruit purées. No artificial syrups, no nonsense—just vibrant flavour, silky smooth texture, and good clean fun.

drinks.name: The TM Classic Frozen Margarita
drinks.description: Our flagship pour. 100% premium blue agave tequila, freshly pressed lime juice, and pure organic agave nectar, frozen to silky perfection. Finished with a fine sea salt or citrus rim.

drinks.name: Spicy Mango Habanero
drinks.description: Sun-ripened Alphonso mango purée balanced with a warm habanero tingle, fresh Mexican lime, and premium tequila. Served with a zesty tajín chilli-lime rim.

drinks.name: Strawberry & Garden Basil Smash
drinks.description: Sweet wild strawberry purée muddled with aromatic fresh garden basil, tart lime, and smooth blanco tequila. A fragrant, summery party standout.

drinks.name: Passionfruit & Coconut Paloma
drinks.description: Tart tropical passionfruit purée and pink grapefruit juice shaken with blue agave tequila, softened with refreshing coconut water and a hint of lime.

drinks.name: Watermelon & Fresh Mint Refresher
drinks.description: Cold-pressed sweet watermelon juice, hand-picked garden mint, crisp lime, and 100% agave tequila. Exceptionally light, hydrating, and naturally sweet.

drinks.name: The Virgin Mockingbird (0.0% ABV)
drinks.description: All the festival energy and vibrant flavour, without the alcohol. Freshly pressed lime, artisan fruit purées, organic agave, and sparkling botanical sodas.

customNoteHeading: Want a Custom Menu for Your Flock?
customNote: Every celebration is unique! When you book any Tequila Mockingbirds package, we consult with you ahead of time so you can choose your favourite frozen flavours, add seasonal specials, or coordinate bespoke colours to match your event theme.
